notes.title: Major Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!


We've been working on this update for months, and it's finally here! In addition to fixes, improvements, and balance tweaks, it also introduces brand-new gameplay mechanics and fresh content. This is our biggest update yet — thank you for your support and patience!



Gameplay changes:

 

Missions:

New story mission added: Airdrop

Enemy positions and patrols have been revamped in most missions to address new features (disguise and "silent" weapons)

More missions can now be finished without raising an alarm

Increased mission difficulty towards the final year

Chosen game difficulty now better reflects the number of enemies present on missions

Changed the amount of awarded resources for some missions

 

Combat:

Added Welrod - new "silent" weapon, can be acquired from mission Airdrop

De Lisle Carbine is now considered a "silent" weapon

Added a 30% familiarity bonus to Commando class for "silent" weapons

Buffed critical chance of burst weapons, increasing both lower and upper threshold, while making the scaling lower for medic class

Reduced Throwing knife range from 10 to 6 tiles

Increased AP cost of shooting with the Mauser rifle from 18 to 21

Sapper now automatically stops before stepping on a mine

 

BaseCamp changes:


Animated base - added many new animations, all recruits now move around, and are affected by time speed

New building - Canteen, which can be used to change food portion sizes (Kitchen is required to build Canteen)

New recruit job - Lumberjack

Player no longer gets wood from missions, but has to assign his recruits to work to acquire wood

Player can have up to 2 lumberjacks

Wood production of a Lumberjack is calculated based on recruit's strength, illness and injury.

Lumberjack has to be present at his workplace to produce wood

Remade healing system

Units heal slower and also have 3 injury phases: critical, medium and light

Healing gets exponentially slower based on the injury level

Critically injured units are no longer able to work or go on missions

Healing on Normal difficulty is faster than on Hard and Insane difficulty

Lowered passive healing (healing for units which are not in Hospital)

Locked extra medical care behind Hospital upgrade

Added a level requirement for Armory's Weaponmaster to repair new "silent" guns

Temporary tent slot added to the HQ interface. It can be used for 1 extra recruit space, with a price of a small morale debuff

Blizzard now forces soldiers inside their barracks, stopping lumberjacks from working

 

Morale changes:


New morale system, tweaked buff and debuff amounts

Added new morale buff Hope which decreases with each year slowly turning into Exhaustion

Added new morale icons into the Soldiers panel (upper right part of the UI header in BaseCamp)

An additional panel can be opened from the Soldiers panel to explain the daily morale gain or loss in detail for each character

Changed critical debuffs for insufficient food and heating in winter. These debuffs get gradually worse when soldiers don't eat or use heating.

Each day with available food or heating reduces the debuffs until they turn back to buffs

Uniforms now get visually damaged based on their durability. Each uniform has 3 stages with the 3rd stage causing a morale debuff

 

Other Changes:



UI:

Changed tooltip for total wood production and consumption

Changed Hospital UI, to show both injury and illness for each unit, while also showing the estimated time to heal

Expedition UI now show all units, even the unavailable ones with an explanation

Temporary tent UI can always be opened now, even if there is no unit assigned

Added new notifications to explain some events more clearly

 

Bug fixes:



Fixed inventory softlock when unit reaches 0 AP with an item in hand

Fixed item duping via trade menu when equipping weapon/helmet to a dead unit

Fixed a bug that allowed skipping upgrades and buying the same upgrade more than once

Fixed incorrect information on Zaitsev's introduction card

Fixed Brute perk triggering without breaking player's disguise

Fixed not being able to use the Panzerfaust with 18 AP

Kitchen no longer consumes wood when there is no food

 

General:



Tank (and mortar) now shoots every round after successfully targetting an ally

nerfed the Entertainer trait

Alwin Groot no longer has the Entertainer trait

Uniforms visually changes based on their durability. Each uniform has 3 stages, from clean all the way to torn.

 

Settings:



Added an option for auto-stopping when an enemy is discovered

Added an option to disable soldiers audio responses for commands



We squashed countless bugs during testing — some big, some tiny, some truly weird. But with so much new content, a few sneaky ones might’ve survived. If you spot any, don’t be shy — let us know and we’ll chase them down with a digital flyswatter!

Since this update brings many changes to the game, we recommend starting a new campaign. However, we also tested the new version with old saves, and everything seemed to work fine.


Once again, huge thanks to everyone for your support and feedback.



Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.5
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

Before the weekend, we’re bringing you a new update that enhances your gameplay experience and addresses several issues reported by the community. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, and we’re grateful for every report you send our way!

With this update, you’ll no longer need to reassign units to their workstations after they’ve been treated in the hospital, making base management much more seamless. Additionally, we’ve made some balance adjustments, giving the Heavy Gunner a significant advantage when using machine guns, further emphasizing their role on the battlefield. We’ve also adjusted the behavior of German officers, who will now recognize the player in a standard German uniform, increasing the authenticity of the game.
We’ve addressed technical issues as well, including fixing a soft lock that could occur when a player ran out of AP and was unable to place a weapon in their inventory. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to more of your feedback! Enjoy the update and have a fantastic weekend.


General changes


 Assigned units will automatically return to their workstations after treatment.
 Changed base AP cost of using a MachineGun to 10
 Classes other than HeavyGunner have a 100% AP cost penalty for using a heavy MachineGun
 The German officer recognizes the player in a standard German uniform.
 Added officer enemies on warehouse missions and EnemyCamp mission
 Added virtual keyboard to enable renaming saves while using a gamepad
 Added action hints to the initial settings menu
 Added action hints to the reset/unlock all buttons in the Skirmish setup screen
 Unit/staff layout scrolls to selected slot if its out of view
 Side window (Character/Perks/Inventory) in BaseCamp building UI now closes before the main window when using escape


Bugfixes


 Fixed a soft lock when the player runs out of all AP and is unable to place a weapon in the inventory.
 Fixed an issue that could cause player units to become undetectable
 Fixed "Begin" action shortcut not working during mine placement
 Fixed chain link doors on RadarStation
 Fixed skip action button icon not displaying correctly
 Fixed "Begin" action shortcut not working during mine placement


We hope you enjoy these improvements! Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing more exciting updates in the future!
Stay in touch with us on our Discord, where we are open to all good suggestions on how to make Forgotten but Unbroken the best experience. 

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.4
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

We are excited to introduce the latest update for Forgotten But Unbroken! This release brings a variety of exciting features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.We’re bringing gamepad support to the game! We've also improved the UI in the base, making it easier for players to quickly assess their resources. This update introduces the ability to use a German uniform to deceive enemy patrols! Plus, many other fixes and improvements to deliver the best possible gaming experience.

General changes:


 a German uniform in combination with a German weapon and a German helmet can now activate a new 'Disguise' state, in which the unit cannot be detected when stepping on detection tiles (this does not work for Ustashe and Hlinka Guard uniforms); if the uniform is too damaged (illustrated by a red icon next to the item), it does not provide the 'Disguise' ability
 Update AI for "inexperienced" (Hlinka Guard, Ustashe)
 Lucky Bastard now activates only if units are more than 5 meters apart from each other
 Added support for gamepad controls
 Update for timing of automatic weapons in covers
 It's no longer possible to loot primary weapon of an ally with an active respawn timer
 Added additional action hints to mission UI
 Various UI windows (e.g. buildings in Base Camp, Inventory, Mission start screen, etc.) can now also be controlled using keyboard
 Re-worked BaseCamp UI header
 Replaced Glass resource icon
 Disabled "low resource" notifications in Base Camp



Bugfixes:


 Fixed BaseCamp UI being visible behind pause menu and its submenus
 Fixed unit name blocking left click input when attacking an enemy
 Fixed building icons appearing inside a building in some cases
 Fix for inventory not removing move AP when taking item with RMB from other inventory when trading
 Fixed selector not being visible if selecting another unit while hovering over an interactive object
 Fixed detection tiles calculation when killing an enemy soldier using a melee attack
 Fixed Czech voiceover before the LostTeam mission
 Fixed attack shield selection index being off due to "no sight" shields
 QuietCottage - fixed grid lines inside a barn appearing too high
 Quarry - fixed an issue with stairs
 RocketBase (Rocket) - removed visible volumes
 EnemyCamp - fixed soldiers sometimes being able to run through fence
 Fixed revive timer decreasing too fast after an already revived unit dies again
 Fueldump - adjusted colliders to prevent units shooting through small gaps in closed windows
 various occlusion culling fixes


We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements! Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing more exciting updates in the future!
Stay in touch with us on our Discord, where we are open to all good suggestions on how to make Forgotten but Unbroken the best experience. 

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Warfront League Revealed!
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

We have some exciting news for our fans! In partnership with the publisher Microprose, we are launching a new competitive mode, the Warfront League, which will run throughout the entire year. Players will complete daily challenges and accumulate points, which will be tallied at the end of each month. The top three players at the end of each month will receive attractive prizes!

The first player will receive an exclusive game from the publisher Microprose – and we can already reveal that the February title will be the highly acclaimed Sea Power! In addition to the game itself, the player will also receive a limited-edition RGB mousepad from Forgotten But Unbroken. The second and third players will also receive this exclusive mousepad, adding to their gaming experience.

Additionally, we are introducing the possibility for players to customize their controls and tailor the game to their preferences, ensuring the best possible gaming experience.

We are also excited to announce the addition of a Chinese localization for the game, broadening the accessibility and experience for even more players, and we are also bringing a bundle of bug fixes to further improve the overall experience.

We look forward to your participation in the Warfront League and wish you the best of luck in the competition!

Gameplay changes


 added a new settings tab - Controls, where players can view and rebind action keybindings
 successful quicksave during a mission now shows a notification
 added extra QoL actions to some menus (e.g. rename/delete/confirm actions in the Save menu)
 new keybinding icons
 added Skirmish ranking history
 added Skirmish monthly ranking
 Defender perk is no longer triggered in stealth mode
 Overburdened unit will now play a corresponding voice line on selection
 critical chance for Bren and Browning for close proximity is now relative to Burst skill and can reach up to 100%
 added a shortcut to swap to previous character during a mission
 added a shortcut to swap to previous/next character in Inventory view
 added a shortcut to swap to previous/next character in Trade view
 Chinese localization added 


Bugfixes


Fixed resources not being localized
 Fixed daily challenge inventory picking up item of 0 value when out of money
 Fixed resolution dropdown scrolling speed
 Fixed Navmesh on Trainbridge level, causing units to get stuck.
 Fixed Navmesh on Quarry level, causing units to move in wrong directions.
 Starting mission with Overburdened unit no longer fails loading a mission
 Fixed occlusion issues on Sawmill, causing the environment to disappear while aiming.
 Fix for Brute (moving) target available-tile search to avoid units overlapping
 Fixed Soft lock when defender target would get too far while overwatch is playing
 Fixed IK for payback perk has been updated to fix incorrect attack pose
 Fixed missions not expiring properly in some cases
 Fixed food visuals not updating in the Kitchen
 Fixed small issues with some character models
 Fixed missing notification for full inventory in base/skirmish
 Fixed unit state icons not appearing in Skirmish Inventory
 Fixed character details (age, nationality) of some recruits
 Fixed Clutch or Kick achievement not triggering properly
 A temporary fix for a really rare issue where cutscenes prevent the game from starting: we are adding an option in the settings to skip cutscenes, and we are working on identifying the cause of this rare issue.


We’re Listening!

We can’t wait to hear what you think about the changes and look forward to your continued support as we develop the game further.

notes.title: First Major Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

We are excited to announce the first major update for Forgotten but Unbroken! Thanks to the decreasing number of reported bugs, we were able to focus on the first content update, which changes everything. This update brings a host of new features, difficulty, soundtrack improvements, and fixes designed to enhance your experience and make the game even more engaging.

What’s New:

New Difficulty - Insane: We've added a new Insane difficulty setting for players looking for a greater challenge. Test your skills with tougher enemies, more intense gameplay, and additional events that will occur in your base, making every decision even more crucial. 

Steam Achievements: Unlock a variety of new achievements as you progress through the game! Show off your accomplishments and challenge yourself to complete them all.

Soundtrack Available for Purchase: Immerse yourself in the world of Forgotten but Unbroken with our official soundtrack. By purchasing it, you can support the development of the game while enjoying the music anytime.

Skirmish Mode with Daily challenge: For those who prefer quick, action-packed gameplay, we've introduced a standalone skirmish mode with a ranking system. Compete against players around the world and rise through the ranks! Now you can challenge the German elites whenever you want. Maybe even several of them at once...

Insane… On behalf of the development team, we recommend this difficulty to the fiercest and the most skilled of the players. It will test your abilities beyond your limits. Enemy units have been added across the maps. Manual saves are disabled and all you can use is one autosave slot. Your base will be truly tested by a fierce blizzard. Can it be won? Yes, but it will be tough. Very tough... You will start and fail. You will start and fail again, and only when you do everything right and have the right dose of luck, will you have a chance. Yes, luck is also needed. The partisans certainly needed it...


Gameplay changes


 aside from a few missions, you will not be limited by the objective of keeping story characters alive. If a story character falls, they will be pulled out of the battle as if injured.
 new events in the base, such as blizzards, radio interception, and the possibility of injury during expeditions. These are active for the Hard and Insane difficulties. 
 new sfx for "Reload All" button
 added (missing) 2 adrenaline injections to Matt The Ghost Urban's inventory
 added 5 more voice lines for Wehrmacht to avoid repeating same line too often
 added (missing) knife to Otto Skorzeny's inventory
 optimized BaseCamp warroom scene


Bugfixes


 fix for inventory highlight and stack check for Mines, Adrenaline Injections, Lockpickers and Tools
 fixed enemy not detecting player when opening door
 fixed missing "Miss" hitmark for Bow weapon
 fixed enemy hero outline after bow kill
 fixed MP35 reload timing
 Brute lvl.3 ability rotation fix
 Brute lvl.3 ability will no longer be called if soldier is behind MachineGun or Mortar
 fixed multiple avenger units soft lock
 fixed queuing pistol perk abilities for instances when unit is hit multiple times
 fixed IK issue when unit is changing cover during overwatch
 fixed follower enemy index switch on load if enemy hierarchy has been changed due to dead enemy soldiers
 dead units are now loaded to a "dead pose" instead of a ragdoll to avoid dead units being loaded on different positionsd
 fixed Mad Jack sword attack damage
 fixed Cowboy perk with overwatch active breaking animation
 fixed too dark lighting on player models on multiple maps



We’re Listening!

This is just the beginning, and we are committed to making Forgotten but Unbroken the best it can be. We can’t wait to hear what you think about the changes and look forward to your continued support as we develop the game further.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.content:

Among other things, we fixed the Auto Reload button and focused on the issue with the Inventory, where your items were disappearing. For this reason, the Armory has gone through several updates. notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

Yesterday's update was not up on Steam for a long time because it contained a bug that caused the game to crash. We reacted to the issue within an hour. Today, update 1.0.6 is getting a second chance, in an expanded form with further adjustments to game balance, gameplay and a significant number of bugs reported by you, which we are fixing on a daily basis. Thank you for every bug report!  The list is really long and we are working in all the directions where your reactions converge.  We have expanded the knowledge of our advisor Max so that he can help you when you don't know what to do. We have also simplified the weapon reloading of your units before a mission. We've provided better rotation of battle voices so that characters don't repeat the same sentences too often in succession. We've made several minor changes to the UI and we believe everyone will find something in the list that will improve their experience while playing Forgotten but Unbroken.

Balance and Gameplay changes


 Max Advisor can advise you in case of resource shortages as well as what to do in case of negative events in the base. 
 Added Reload button to WarRoom - from now on you can automatically reload all units in War room. 
 Updated event illustrations
 Player units will be now considered as "left the danger area" when detonating dynamites on Radar Station and Rocket Base Rocket at the end of the mission
 [TrainBridge] bridge explosion no longer kills units on the other side of the bridge
 [TrainBridge] the area under the bridge is now traversable after the explosion
 Letters can no longer be closed by clicking outside the letter itself
 Changed positions of buttons inside the Shooting Range to be more consistent with other buildings
 Reduced the interactable area of some UI elements to improve screen edge camera movement
 Units will now repeat same voice line less often
 Added "request not available" text to the Radio UI
 Optimized Main Menu and Inventory scenes.


Bugfixes


 Fixed DetectionTiles when loading open doors
 Fixed Panzerfaust having 0/1 ammo (ammo counter for Panzerfaust will no longer be displayed)
 Fixed possibility to become "invisible" on Detection Tiles during stealth
 Fixed loot moving after load
 Fixed a locker on Sawmill that spawned an item bag on load
 [TrainBridge] bridge explosion now doesn't re-play after loading a save
 Fixed "Accept All" button not being interactable during Supplies Delivery in some cases
 Added highlight to restart game option after mission fail
 Fixed stuck bleeding enemy behind machine gun
 Fixed overlapping characters after first mission
 Added the option to disable alembic animations causing crashes.
 Added missing localization 
 Fixed soft lock by placing mine on a path of a patroling unit 
 Fixed Ivan Mikhailovich Sidorenko arriving with a wrong ammo type
 Fixed Armory heating tooltip showing incorrect info
 Fixed Sawmill defense mission having an incorrect spawn date
 Fixed SpyNet not sending the "no more recruits available" response
 Fixed issues with mouse-only camera movement
 Fixed some settings not re-applying in some cases
 Fixed loading unlocked doors
 Fixed Navmesh on Warehouse level, causing players to run in wrong directions.


Coming soon


 More battle voices for German soldiers to make the rotation of voices more pleasant.
 Advanced tutorial with starting quests in camp
 New UI for difficulty selection. 


Stay in touch with us on our Discord, where we are open to all good suggestions on how to make Forgotten but Unbroken the best experience.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!

Another day and another update in which we reflected on your feedback, which is extremely valuable to us. We made the game for you, and that’s why we want to make sure you truly enjoy it. Besides fixing all the reported bugs, we are mainly working on two fronts where your reactions overlap. We are working on better explaining the game mechanics and also balancing the difficulty.

Today is a turning point in terms of difficulty, as we’ve added an option to choose, and we believe you’ll select the one that allows you to enjoy the game as much as possible.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.4
notes.content:
Dear Forgotten but Unbroken community!



We are working hard to bring you the best possible experience. We’ve been listening to your feedback and we are here with a new update not only fixing Bugs, but also the Balance and Quality of Life features for our basecamp. You can find a list of resolved issues down below. 

You can already find an advisor, who will tell you important informations about the features of the camp. But it doesn’t end there. We are preparing an even bigger “tutorial” overhaul which should clarify all the mechanics in basecamp. 

Balance and Gameplay changes


 Base Camp tutorial overhaul
 Max as an Advisor has also been reworked. He is now easier to find and will better explain features of the Base Camp
 When starting a New Game, player will be protected from "Rats Event" until the end of first Winter
 Mad Jack Churchill can no longer attack friendly units
 Cooldown for expeditions is visible 
 Cooldown for radio contact with your Allies is visible
 Increased penalty for ignoring missions
 Heating has its own UI panel
 The button icons for building upgrades have been unified and made easier to read


Bugfixes


 Fixed Martin multiplying in the HQ
 Fixed weapon dealer stopping game permanently
 Fixed wrong mission region
 Fixed enemy taking overwatch behind machine gun
 Fixed Mad Jack Churchill RMB cancel Bow action
 Fixed environment disappearing on Trainstation2 when the player goes to aim mode.
 Fixed Roofs not disappearing on Cemetery level.
 Fixed grid tiles not working properly in the scaffolding area on Cemetery level, causing units to run in wrong directions.
 Fixed mission not being loaded and save file corruption due to pressing Start Mission twice


We will deliver more balance improvements soon, along with the option to choose your preferred difficulty level from Normal and Hard modes. All the enhancements are already in progress and will be available in the coming days.

notes.title: Free limited playtest is around the corner!
notes.content:
Hey gamers! 

Get ready for an exclusive sneak peek at our upcoming game as part of our Kickstarter campaign! We're excited to announce that a free limited playtest will be available for you this Monday.

We want to give our players the opportunity to experience the game firsthand and provide feedback to make improvements before the final release. We believe that this will not only help us create a better game, but also strengthen the relationship between our team and the community.

Thank you for your support in our Kickstarter campaign and we are looking forward to the upcoming playtest!
